hook: 字首 dis-＝分開／否定——工廠專管拆掉與否定。
script: disperse 打散；distort 扭歪。discredit 讓信用散掉；dismantle 拆解。disparage 貶低拆台；dissuade 勸阻拆念頭。dispassionate 抽離感情；discord 不和。disarray 混亂；disavow 否認切割。

members.senseAnchor: distribute loosely; to cause to separate and go in different directions
members.speakLineEn: Disperse rumors with a public correction log.
members.speakLineZh: 用公開勘誤日誌打散謠言。

related.synonyms: scatter, sprinkle, dot, dust, dissipate, dispel

members.senseAnchor: tear down so as to make flat with the ground; take apart into its constituent pieces
members.speakLineEn: Dismantle incentives that reward only positives.
members.speakLineZh: 拆掉只獎勵陽性的誘因。

members.speakLineEn: Do not disparage fields you have not read.
members.speakLineZh: 不要貶低你沒讀過的領域。

members.speakLineEn: Good mentoring can dissuade fraudulent shortcuts.
members.speakLineZh: 好指導能勸阻造假捷徑。
寫冷靜公正的方法批評。

members.speakLineEn: Discord between prereg and paper needs explanation.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊與論文不一致需解釋。

members.speakLineEn: Code in disarray hides silent bugs.
members.speakLineZh: 混亂程式碼隱藏沉默錯誤。

members.senseAnchor: refuse to acknowledge; disclaim knowledge of; responsibility for, or association with
members.speakLineEn: Authors must disavow forged figures publicly.
members.speakLineZh: 作者必須公開否認偽造圖。

members.senseAnchor: make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret; disclose to view as by removing a cover
members.speakLineEn: Disclose all deviations from the plan.
members.speakLineZh: 揭露所有偏離計畫之處。

related.synonyms: unwrap, reveal, discover, expose, divulge, break
related.antonyms: wrap, cover, conform to, keep, make, promote, repair

pitfalls: disinterested≈公正無利益；uninterested＝不感興趣（另記）
